scenarios.prompt: A season has free and paid lanes sharing progression. Define stable season/tier/reward IDs and idempotent claims with paid eligibility from entitlement-grant.

criteria.identity: Stable season/tier/reward IDs survive save/load and version changes.
criteria.ownership: Track progress/claims are separate from entitlement verification and unrelated settings/story data.
criteria.evidence: Claim retry, exact tier, late purchase, rollover and duplicate callbacks are tested.
